card.name: Linking words before clotting test names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "as", "including" or an opening parenthesis, right before a list of clotting tests (PT, INR, fibrinogen) or anticoagulant activity, in monitoring text.

modes.label: Monitoring of clotting
modes.description: "of" after monitoring, ahead of INR or anticoagulation levels.
modes.example: More frequent monitoring<< of>> International Normalized Ratio (INR)

modes.label: Listing coagulation tests
modes.description: "as", "including" or "(" introducing named clotting tests like PT and PTT.
modes.example: routine coagulation tests such<< as>> Prothrombin Time (PT)
